Title: Monitoring system changes for Azure Redis Cache

Body.Content: The Azure Redis Cache service has deployed a new monitoring system, and we’ll be turning off the old system on March 15, 2015. We recommend you take steps to ensure that you continue to receive monitoring data as expected. Please read this post for more details: Azure Redis Cache Monitoring changes.
